reviews.author: Roger whitener
reviews.text: Mike’s Tree Service is great! They did an amazing job at our house today. I asked for some thinning and wanted him to top the tree. He recommended not to top but to just trim as it could harm the tree. My sister is a certified arborist and has made the same recommendations. She works for a tree company in Texas and says the quote was very reasonable compared to some jobs she’s quoted recently. We are extremely pleased with the work and the customer service we received. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a fair price and great work. Thanks Mike!

reviews.author: Greg Melish
reviews.text: Mike and his team did and excellent job taking down a large dead tree in our yard. They are extremely professional, communicate well, and did a great job! I would absolutely recommend them.
